name: spank
description: Slap your MacBook and Claude Code feels it: a face, a yelp, and optionally a stopped turn

threshold.title: Slap sensitivity (g)
threshold.description: The smallest shake that counts as a slap, in g. Raise it if typing counts as slapping; lower it if desk knocks are missed.

stop_level.title: Level that stops Claude
stop_level.description: With /slaps claude on, a slap of this level (1-5) or harder stops Claude's running turn.

face_series.title: Face series
face_series.description: Whose face pops up after a slap, and whose voice yelps.

face_size.title: Face size
face_size.description: How big the face above the prompt may get; it shrinks to fit the terminal either way.

volume.title: Voice volume
volume.description: 0 is silent, 1 is as recorded, up to 4.
